profile.summary: QA Automation Engineer with 2+ years of experience in UI, API, DB, functional and performance testing, backed by software development experience in Java, Spring Boot and microservices. Strong in Playwright, TypeScript, Selenium, Cucumber/BDD, POM, REST/GraphQL, Snowflake, Postman and JMeter. Experienced across E-Commerce, Procurement & Supply Chain, Banking, Healthcare, Insurance and Logistics, with ownership of automation frameworks, RCA and release validation.

points: Built REST APIs and ReactJS applications for MES and inventory systems; optimized MySQL/PostgreSQL operations and developed VMD/LED device discovery.
Developed and enhanced web applications using OutSystems, implementing application workflows, UI components and data-driven functionality.

projects.description: Developed a scalable UI automation framework for AI-driven sourcing, supplier onboarding, approvals, contracts and analytics; automated REST/GraphQL validation and reconciled UI/API results with Snowflake data. Used network interception/Cortex for troubleshooting and JMeter for performance validation, followed by RCA and release reporting.

Owned automation for multi-country B2B/B2C e-commerce journeys with reusable MFA/session handling and data validation, delivering functional, regression, accessibility, cross-browser and performance coverage with RCA/JIRA defect management. Received the GEM Award for outstanding contribution.

Built a BDD-based Playwright automation framework from scratch; independently automated critical Salesforce healthcare workflows and delivered a POC for complex iFrame handling for reliable end-to-end automation.
Engineered JMeter performance testing for critical banking services, including payment gateway integration, with load, stress and endurance testing up to 10,000+ concurrent threads.

Developed and maintained 20+ JMeter scripts across multiple logistics features using CSV-driven datasets and distributed AWS EC2 execution, performing daily performance testing with 10,000+ concurrent users.
Performed Android/iOS functional and regression testing; developed and maintained Java-Appium UI automation for critical insurance workflows.
Supported enterprise healthcare application validation through functional/regression testing, defect analysis and quality-focused delivery.

achievements: 5th University Rank & 1st College Rank in Graduation
